name: scene_detect
description: Find the cuts and scene changes in a video. Returns a numbered list of scenes with start, end and length, which is useful for chaptering, splitting a video into shots, or finding where something changes. threshold controls sensitivity (lower finds subtler changes). With thumbnails true, one image per scene is saved and attached.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

threshold.description: Scene-change sensitivity from 0.05 to 0.95. Default 0.3; use 0.15–0.2 for subtle changes, 0.4+ for hard cuts only.

min_scene_length.description: Ignore scenes shorter than this. Default 1 second. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

max_scenes.description: Stop after this many scenes. Default 200.

thumbnails.description: Save (and attach) one thumbnail per scene. Default false.

output_dir.description: Folder for thumbnails, relative to the workspace. Default <name>_scenes next to the video.
